title: BaseCoat onboarding telemetry scorecard v1
description: Reusable scorecard schema for goal-based loop metrics. Emitted by onboarded repos during the weekly adoption-metrics run.

schema_version.description: Version of the telemetry scorecard schema.

collected_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this scorecard was collected.

profile.description: Onboarding profile active for this repo.

telemetry_mode.description: Telemetry mode active for this repo. Derived from onboarding profile when omitted.

app_insights_connected.description: Whether APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING is configured for this repo.

metrics.description: Goal-based loop metrics for this repo.

reviewer_closure.description: Ratio of PRs that received at least one review before merge over the measurement window.

intake_completeness.description: Ratio of issues opened with required template fields filled in (title, body, acceptance criteria) over the measurement window.

merge_health.description: CI pass rate over the last 20 measurable runs. Mirrors ci_pass_rate_last_20_runs from latest.json.

drift_trend.description: Signed percentage change in basecoat_coverage.percentage versus the prior snapshot. Negative values indicate drift away from baseline.

readiness.description: Telemetry readiness status for this repo.

value.description: Numeric value of the metric. Null when data is unavailable.

status.description: Signal health status based on thresholds.

threshold_warn.description: Warning threshold. Signal transitions to warning when value drops below this.

threshold_critical.description: Critical threshold. Signal transitions to critical when value drops below this.

note.description: Optional human-readable note about this metric value.

overall.description: Overall telemetry readiness for this repo.

missing_dependencies.description: List of missing telemetry dependencies that must be resolved before full readiness.
